name: @edgegamers/s2s-portal
description: Sends game events to the EdgeGamers CS portal through a local SQLite outbox (Jailbreak rounds in full; TTT rounds, kills, bodies, purchases and special rounds), holds a live WebSocket that applies skin changes made on the portal, is WeaponPaints' storage over the portal API, and hands PUG matches from the portal to the PUG plugin and their score back.

portal_url.description: Portal root, e.g. https://cs.edgegamers.com. Events go to {root}/api/v1/events. Empty = the plugin stays idle.

api_key.description: This server's API key (egs_...), shown once when an admin registers the server under Servers in the portal. Empty = the plugin stays idle.

batch_interval_ms.description: How often the sender drains the outbox, in ms. Floored at 1000.

batch_size.description: Most events per batch. Clamped to 1-500 (the portal's limit).

max_outbox_events.description: Most unsent events kept on disk. Past this the oldest are dropped and logged. 0 = no limit.

live.description: Hold a WebSocket to the portal so skin changes made on the website apply in game at once. Off = players use !wp, and the policy updates at map start.

live_url.description: Live channel URL. Empty = portal_url's /api/v1/live as ws(s)://. Set only if the gateway is on another host.

debug.description: Log every batch sent and every event queued.
